elements.requirement: In the Late Payment of Commercial Debts (Interest) Act 1998, the phrase "contract for the supply of goods or services" has the meaning given in section 2(2).
elements.quote: “contract for the supply of goods or services” has the meaning given in section 2(2)

elements.requirement: In the Late Payment of Commercial Debts (Interest) Act 1998, "contract price" means the price in a contract of sale of goods or the money consideration referred to in section 2(2)(b) in any other contract for the supply of goods or services.
elements.quote: “contract price” means the price in a contract of sale of goods or the money consideration referred to in section 2(2)(b) in any other contract for the supply of goods or services

elements.requirement: In the Late Payment of Commercial Debts (Interest) Act 1998, subject to section 13(2), "purchaser" means the buyer in a contract of sale or the person who contracts with the supplier in any other contract for the supply of goods or services.
elements.quote: “purchaser” means (subject to section 13(2)) the buyer in a contract of sale or the person who contracts with the supplier in any other contract for the supply of goods or services

elements.requirement: In the Late Payment of Commercial Debts (Interest) Act 1998, "qualifying debt" means a debt falling within section 3(1).
elements.quote: “qualifying debt” means a debt falling within section 3(1)

elements.requirement: In the Late Payment of Commercial Debts (Interest) Act 1998, "statutory interest" means interest carried by virtue of the term implied by section 1(1).
elements.quote: “statutory interest” means interest carried by virtue of the term implied by section 1(1)

elements.requirement: In the Late Payment of Commercial Debts (Interest) Act 1998, subject to section 13(2), "supplier" means the seller in a contract of sale of goods or the person who does one or more of the things mentioned in section 2(3) in any other contract for the supply of goods or services.
elements.quote: “supplier” means (subject to section 13(2)) the seller in a contract of sale of goods or the person who does one or more of the things mentioned in section 2(3) in any other contract for the supply of goods or services

elements.requirement: In the Late Payment of Commercial Debts (Interest) Act 1998, any reference, however worded, to an agreement or to contract terms includes a reference to both express and implied terms, including terms established by a course of dealing or by such usage as binds the parties.
elements.quote: any reference (however worded) to an agreement or to contract terms includes a reference to both express and implied terms (including terms established by a course of dealing or by such usage as binds the parties)

thresholds.what: minimum number of things mentioned in section 2(3) a person must do in any other contract for the supply of goods or services to be defined as a supplier
thresholds.quote: does one or more of the things mentioned in section 2(3)
